title: Turn on Dark Mode on iPhone
prerequisites: Mirror your iPhone into Hodey (menu → Show iPhone) and start on the Home Screen, in Light mode.

speech.demonstrate: On your iPhone, tap Settings, the grey gear. I've highlighted it.
speech.hint: Which app holds all of your phone's options?

steps.explain: Settings is where every iPhone option lives, including how the screen looks.

speech.demonstrate: Scroll down a little and tap Display & Brightness.
speech.hint: Look for the setting about your screen.

steps.explain: Display & Brightness controls light and dark appearance, text size and brightness.

mistakes.correction: That's Wallpaper. Tap Settings at the top left to go back, then choose Display & Brightness.

speech.demonstrate: Under Appearance, tap Dark. The whole screen will turn dark.
speech.hint: Appearance has two choices. Which one is easier on the eyes at night?

steps.explain: Dark Mode uses light text on dark backgrounds, which is easier on your eyes in low light.

mistakes.correction: That opened Text Size. Go back; Dark is under Appearance at the top.
